value.rationale: The canonical multiset restaurant process has a naturally missing high-multiplicity growth regime: the closest paper shows one cubic-exponential failure of CLT but gives no boundary. A complete sharp power-exponential trichotomy supplies the variance scale where Gaussian behavior surprisingly survives unbounded ratios, an explicit infinite non-Gaussian q-convolution at the boundary, and the one-exponential dominated regime. The full continuum of c and beta parameters and moment laws have a clear structural connection to endpoint variance concentration, not a trivial finite enumeration.
